goal: When every task in a phase is DONE and landed on the phase branch and the loop-path gate and [phase] verify evaluated against the phase-branch tree pass, the worker pushes the phase branch and ensures exactly one open PR onto the true base whose body aggregates every task's grader receipts and held-out verdict.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-worktree packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- archive_completed_phases (the completion detection and the [phase] verify invocation whose cwd today is the operator checkout -- the gate must instead evaluate the phase-branch tree); module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- archive_phases (the daemon caller under the merge lock); module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/pr.py -- render_pr_body, _ensure_pr, and the injectable GhRunner: lift the per-task receipt rendering to phase scope
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- HeldOutGateEvaluated: the per-run domain event carrying the held-out outcome and receipts; read via list_domain_events(run_id)
references: docs/held-out-gate.md -- verdict semantics (NO_GATE vs PASS vs FAIL) the body must render faithfully
constraints: [phase] verify runs against a checkout of the phase branch, never the operator's checkout; a non-zero exit opens no PR and leaves the phase unarchived with the refusal logged
Exactly one PR per phase: the first completion creates it, later sweeps refresh (edit) it -- never a duplicate

The PR body aggregates, for every task in the phase, the run's final grader receipts (from the store) and its held-out verdict (from the HeldOutGateEvaluated domain event, rendering NO_GATE distinctly from PASS); receipts are the harness's verdicts, never re-derived from agent output
The worker pushes and opens/refreshes; it never merges the phase PR
PR-open failures follow the existing never-raise submit discipline: logged and surfaced, never unwinding the sweep
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: No archival-predicate change (the merged-ancestry block is the dependent task's surface); this task ends at the open, receipt-bearing PR
Do not change the per-task pr strategy's own PR flow or body rendering for single-task PRs
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A task with no persisted receipts renders the existing receipt-projection-unavailable line rather than being silently omitted from the body
A phase where one run's held-out verdict is NO_GATE and another's is PASS renders both distinctly
A second sweep with the PR already open edits the body rather than opening a second PR
A red [phase] verify against the phase-branch tree opens no PR even though every task is DONE and landed
